name: gap_to_vwap_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: After a gap open, the developing session VWAP acts as a gravitational attractor because institutional algorithms (TWAP/VWAP algos) that were scheduled to execute at VWAP will naturally pull price toward it. When price opens away from VWAP and diverges further, the institutional reversion pressure builds. By entering when the gap creates a >20 bps deviation from developing VWAP and waiting for the first sign of VWAP convergence, we ride the institutional flow back to VWAP. The edge persists because retail traders ignore VWAP and trade on price action alone, while institutional VWAP algos are the dominant intraday flow.
stock_filter: daily avg volume > ₹200cr; gap > 0.3% (abs); VWAP deviation > 20bps at entry time

conditions: gap_pct < 0 (gap down, price extended below VWAP)
vwap_slope > 0 OR vwap_slope is flattening (VWAP not dropping sharply)
long.confirmation: price crosses above EMA(close, 5) from below while still below VWAP

conditions: gap_pct > 0 (gap up, price extended above VWAP)
short.confirmation: price crosses below EMA(close, 5) from above while still above VWAP

entry.entry_price: limit order at EMA(close, 5) cross price

exit.stop_loss: vwap_dev_bps exceeds 40bps against position OR 0.4% from entry
exit.trailing_stop: once within 5bps of VWAP, trail stop at 15bps from best deviation
exit.signal_exit: if price_vwap_cross_count > 3 in last 30 bars (choppy, no trend to VWAP), exit

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 20; high VIX causes wider VWAP deviations that may not revert
filters.time_filter: best entry window 09:25-11:00 IST; afternoon VWAP reversion is weaker
filters.trend_filter: developing VWAP slope not > 0.5 bps/min (strong trend makes VWAP a moving target)
filters.event_filter: skip earnings day stocks; skip stocks with circuit limit hits
other_filters: skip if stock has crossed VWAP 5+ times already today (choppy, no edge)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — VWAP reversion is driven by institutional execution algorithms and will persist as long as VWAP benchmarking exists

weaknesses: On strong trend days, VWAP itself moves in the trend direction, so price 'touching VWAP' may happen at a worse level than entry, creating a false win that's actually a loss on the trade
The 20bps VWAP deviation threshold generates many signals in volatile sessions but these are lower quality because the VWAP is still developing and noisy in the first 30 minutes
Developing VWAP in the first 30 minutes is heavily influenced by the gap itself, making early signals unreliable (circular reference problem)
prior_art: Berkowitz et al. (1988) VWAP benchmark; adapted for intraday gap trading. Biais et al. (1995) on price discovery and VWAP convergence.
notes: Edge math: 0.66 * 28bps - 0.34 * 25bps = 18.48 - 8.5 = 9.98bps gross. Costs ~9bps RT. Net ~1bps/trade * 3 trades = 3bps daily. The 25bps estimate is optimistic; requires capturing 3-4 high-quality VWAP reversion trades per day. Works best in the 09:30-11:00 window.
